thread:
Tess (Marketing): Morning team — final launch coordination for tomorrow. Need canonical changelog URL, docs shortlink, locked canary start time, webinar CTA + reg link, and lead routing details. Can eng confirm the exact rollout cadence and any micro-maint windows?
Owen (Engineering): Changelog PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelogs/pull/517. It mentions model pinning, default batching changes, and an SDK flag.
Owen (Engineering): Rollout plan: canary at 09:45 PT -> 60m observation -> ramp to 35% at 10:55 PT -> 70% at 12:30 PT -> full by 16:00 PT. Auto-fallback to stable if error_rate > 0.7% sustained over 5m.
Tess (Marketing): Locking canary start is essential for the countdown and embargo. Please confirm feature flag name and health gate thresholds.
Owen (Engineering): Flag: rf_q2_launch = true at 09:45 PT. Health gates: p95 latency < 430ms, error_rate < 0.7%, kv_cache_hit > 60% (5m rolling).
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by Owen for 2026-03-24T16:45:00Z (09:45 PT). Monitors: latency_p95, error_rate, kv_cache_hit_ratio.
Rae (Docs): Docs ready at https://docs.redwood.com/notes/q2-launch  shortlink for marketing: https://rwd.io/q2launch. Added anchors: #model-pinning, #batching-guidance. Also included a short example snippet for SDK pinning.
Marco (Product): Messaging bullets: 1) Predictable inference via model pinning; 2) Reduced unit costs with smarter batching; 3) Safer rollouts with canary + auto-fallback. Include a short benchmark line: "Up to 28% cost savings at comparable p95" linking to our benchmark blog. OK?
Tess (Marketing): Good. Webinar plan: 11:00 PT — 25m demo + 20m Q&A. Reg: https://events.redwood.com/q2-launch. We'll open registration and route attendees to the launch funnel.
Tess (Marketing): Lead routing ask: route webinar signups and launch-page leads to SDR queue 'q2-launch' and tag by region & product interest. Ops?
ops-oncall: Will create HubSpot rule: source=q2_launch -> queue=q2-launch; tags: region form field + interest multi-select. Will test in staging and promote before 08:30 PT tomorrow. Monitoring for lead spike enabled.
Owen (Engineering): Heads-up: embedding endpoint will have a 30s config rotation at 12:05 PT for a param tweak. No expected downtime but avoid embedding-heavy demo calls then.
Tess (Marketing): Noted. We'll schedule the demo flow to avoid 12:05 PT.
Rae (Docs): Added a copyable FAQ for marketing: "How do I pin a model? See Model pinning section for CLI and SDK examples, and recommended rollout settings."
Marco (Product): Launch checklist: docs link  ok; changelog  ok; canary + rollback  ok; webinar + slide deck  marketing to share deck by 08:00 PT tomorrow; lead routing  ops to confirm.
ops-oncall: Routing rule created and tested in staging; will promote at 08:20 PT and post confirmation here. Dashboard shared to #gtt-launch.
Tess (Marketing): Embargo timing — plan: canary start at 09:45 PT, public announce at 10:50 PT (10m before webinar). Confirm?
Owen (Engineering): Confirmed. Keep #release-monitor open. If rollback triggers, hold the public announce and notify GTM channel.
Tess (Marketing): I'll queue the scheduled post and hold the publish if release-monitor signals issues. :rocket:
Marco (Product): Support on standby for first 72h.
Rae (Docs): Also uploaded a short demo script snippet that references the docs anchors; marketing can copy paste.
Owen (Engineering): Minor operational note: increased initial autoscaler headroom for first 3 hours to smooth ramp.
ops-oncall: Routing promoted at 08:21 PT; monitoring green. Will update if anomalies occur.
